title: Enabling IPv6 Resolution for Zscaler Domains

blocks.text: You can use Zscaler Client Connector to connect to IPv6 Zscaler servers from an IPv6-only device.
To learn more, see Configuring IPv6 and Understanding IPv6 Support.

This feature is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.8 and later for Windows, Zscaler Client Connector version 4.7 and later for macOS, and Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1 and later for Android. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.
Make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: If Zscaler Client Connector is running on a dual-stack network (IPv4 and IPv6 run simultaneously), a device with an OS that has an IPv4 address assigned to it prefers IPv4. To use only IPv6, remove the IPv4 address from the OS (for statically assigned IP addresses) or configure the DHCP server to issue only IPv6 addresses (for DHCP-assigned IP addresses).
Ensure App Connector and Private Service Edge for Private Access software is upgraded to version 24.353.5 or later. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
Allow IPv6 traffic to pass through on-premises firewalls and allowlist the IPv6 addresses for the Zscaler infrastructure for your on-premises firewalls:
For a list of domains and addresses for Private Access, see Configuring IPv6.
For a list of domains and addresses for Internet & SaaS, see Understanding IPv6 Support.

blocks.text: When these prerequisites are complete, contact Zscaler Support to request IPv6 support for access for your tenant, and then make sure the remaining prerequisites for Private Access and Internet & SaaS IPv6 support are met (including configuring new IdP and service provider endpoints and updating the PAC file).

blocks.heading: Enabling Dual Domain Support for Zscaler Endpoints

blocks.item: Enable IPv6 resolution for Zscaler domains:
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > <OS>.
On the Platform Settings tab, click Edit.
In the Edit Platform Settings window, under General Settings, select Enable IPv6 Resolution for Zscaler Domains.
Configure a forwarding profile with these settings:
Select a Tunnel Driver Type of Packet Filter-Based.
If you use Internet & SaaS, disable Drop IPv6 in Dual Stack Network and Drop IPv6 in IPv6 Only Network.
If you use Internet & SaaS, enable Drop IPv6 Include Traffic When Not Supported.

If you use Internet & SaaS, configure an app profile with Destination Inclusion for IPv6 rules per your network configuration. Zscaler recommends using [2000::/3] to cover all global routable IPv6 addresses.
